did: Rust Rounds now lays out rustc's error in its own words, the way you approved on the prototype, and shows the full coloured printout folded beneath it. A week's ticket now takes a recording for each point it asks you to speak to: one point open at a time, each redone or let go on its own, and an older recording of the whole ticket still counts for every point. Home learned to keep and judge a take per point, and the phone sends a point's take only once home says it can take it. I wrote the home side as patches the coordinator opened, since this session couldn't push to the server.

calls.title: When the phone starts recording a take per point
options: Record per point as soon as this build ships
Record per point once the build knows home serves it, and hold point takes until home says so
calls.why: An older home refuses a point's take, and a refused take is never sent again, so recording per point before home could take it would lose recordings.
calls.undo: Say so, and the phone records per point regardless of what home says; an older home would then refuse those takes.

calls.title: Whether a send may name a ticket other than the one its take was recorded for
options: Refuse a send whose ticket or point differs from what home holds for that take
calls.why: The point is read from the recording itself, so home should never record a take as answering a point it wasn't recorded for. A take home doesn't hold yet is still accepted, as before.
calls.undo: Say so, and home goes back to taking the send's word for it.

left: Nothing on screen says a week sent point by point is waiting on the phone while home hasn't yet said it can take it. Noted on #3248 as a small follow-up.
The branch claude/rr24-server-patch still exists. This session's git access drops branch deletes, so it needs deleting by hand on GitHub.
Playing each point's take in the week's essay is with another worker, not done here.
